name: progressive-reviewer
description: Tells the progressive reviewer what the agent in its pane of Herdr, or its terminal of herdr-core, does, and under herdr-core which session it runs; elsewhere, those hooks do nothing. A prompt of the reviewer's Explore round, Implement or Post review that names a model and an effort on a line of its own puts the session's main loop on them until the process ends or a later round names others.

control.title: reviewer-control
control.description: The reviewer-control program of the reviewer's installation, which each hook runs.
